deviation.what: the self-play share was raised to 0.7 on a fixed block schedule, above §26's 20–30% cap for schedules that are not performance-gated
deviation.why_it_happened: the curriculum was built to run unattended to a games floor; no per-block evaluation gate was implemented, so no transition could ever qualify as PERFORMANCE_PROMOTION
deviation.consequence: c018 makes NO strategic curriculum claim. The curriculum is evidence that real PPO training ran at scale — real games, real optimizer steps, moving weights — and nothing more. Any claim that the self-play schedule *improved* the policy would need performance-gated promotions this run does not have.
deviation.what_would_fix_it: a per-block frozen-panel evaluation whose result gates the next self-play increment, labelling those transitions PERFORMANCE_PROMOTION
